'''DS-224 Colossus''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] located on [[Quesh]] around [[3642 BBY]], when it was destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
DS-224 Colossus appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Quesh. It is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.
